purpose: verify the real executor against the production forward solver at eta = 0

eta0_vs_production_forward.note: the production solver is called directly here, with nothing from this module in the path, so a reordered layer or a misapplied scale would show up

repeat_determinism.requirement: bitwise identical across repeated calls with the same photon keys
repeat_determinism.why_strict: the ensemble method relies on common random numbers cancelling exactly between plus h and minus h. Measured on this hardware the GPU scatter-add is non-deterministic at a relative 1.3e-15 without the flag, which propagates to a difference-quotient jitter of 8.6e-15 of signal and would have been tolerable, but the flag removes it entirely so there is no reason to accept it.
repeat_determinism.measured_source: the non-determinism is in the binned scatter-add, not the transport: per-photon detector ids and escaping weights are bitwise stable across repeats while the binned sums are not. See results/determinism_probe_default.json and results/determinism_probe_deterministic.json.
repeat_determinism.fix: export XLA_FLAGS=--xla_gpu_deterministic_ops=true, which the job scripts now do

ad_path.why_this_matters: a frozen eta would make jacfwd return exactly zero for the geometry columns, which is the failure mode the jnp-only traced path exists to prevent

deterministic_flag_in_preflight_process.why_checked_here: a preflight record describes the process that ran the preflight, not this one

hash_binding_contract: the gate re-verifies every entry in input_hashes and jaxpad_bound_hashes against the files on disk at run time and refuses on any mismatch
verdict: the real executor reproduces the production forward solver at eta = 0, the AD path is live on every column, and repeated calls with the same keys are bitwise identical
